parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; its final Nice to have bullet contains domain experience rather than taxonomy skills.
Credit products, underwriting programs, credit bureau data, and lending regulations are treated as domain knowledge and excluded.
Named analytical techniques without taxonomy entries are listed as unmapped; gradient-boosted models do not imply XGBoost, and experiment design does not explicitly name A/B testing.
The degree label records the highest level named: the PhD is optional, although the Master's degree is explicitly required.
Technologies and practices mentioned only in responsibilities are excluded.
